test_list_tests_flag: test the --gtest_list_tests flag to list all registered Google Test tests
test_list_tests_with_filter: test the --gtest_list_tests flag combined with --gtest_filter to list filtered tests
test_list_tests_default_behavior: test the default behavior when --gtest_list_tests flag is not provided
test_list_tests_override_flags: test that --gtest_list_tests overrides non-filter flags like --gtest_break_on_failure
run_test_executable: run the googletest-list-tests-unittest_ executable with command-line arguments and capture output
